notes.title: V0.271
notes.notes:
Changelog V0.27 (Beta)
Key Changes –
Player Log should no longer reach massive sizes if game is left open.
Multiple savefiles implemented, and load from file option. This should make saving more secure, protect against corrupted files and allow players to more easily load different saves. Game no autosaves on quit, even if you force close the application.
BBEG is now clickable, each click will deal your Actual Damage – speeding up how fast you can clear the BBEG. Also implemented damage text for manual attacks.

Minor Changes –
Legacy Count Achievement requirements changed from 1, 10, 100, 250 to 1, 10, 25, 50 (to reduce boring clicking). Will implement an option to remove Confirmation message in a future update.
Achievement multiplier display in Achievement Tab.
Achievement Tooltip position changed so tooltips don’t go off the side of the screen.
Achievements are now grouped by type.
Twitter Link changed to Reddit. Reddit and Discord achievements remain on Eternity, so each player will only ever have to click them once.

Bug Fixes –
Scrollview error fixed that was preventing players from clicking items in the bottom 100 pixels of the screen.
Fixed bug where treasure income display wasn’t showing correctly for low values or 0.
Fixed bug where some achievements were incorrectly triggering on Eternity Reset.
Treasure achievements should now trigger at correct values.
Multiple typos/incorrect bonus amounts fixed.
